name: Maine

items.label: Maine taxable income
items.note: The standard deduction phases out above $102,250 ($204,550 married) and the $5,150 personal exemption above $341,000.

items.label: Maine income tax
items.note: Includes the 2% surcharge on taxable income over $1 million ($1.5 million married) that starts in 2026.

provisional: Personal exemption of $5,150 is the 2025 amount
